reviewFindings: Replay now restores keyboard focus to a useful live control
Idle artwork loading is bounded to 1200ms; stalled or late assets cannot trap an interaction or restart its entrance
Rejected opaque hover hits clear transient focus without clearing a pinned person
Hover previews keep keyboard Explore available, and projection helpers synchronize the current camera matrix
Live reduced-motion changes and failed scene assets activate the complete semantic fallback and release active controls; unavailable runtimes reject reopening
Stage now participates in monitor surface retention, matching its videoWall ownership
Three forms rest on the authored sloped counter and leave the monitor controls visible
The rejected gathering prototype was removed; Intelligence motion graphics and the stronger material remain the next design pass
Desktop/mobile screenshots reveal remaining composer visual limits: partial cube obstruction/cropping and no contact shadows; these are included in the next design pass
